vocabulary.meaning_en: a sales talk to sell a product or idea; to give such a talk
vocabulary.meaning_ar: عرض بيعي (لإقناع العميل)؛ يقدّم عرضًا بيعيًا
vocabulary.example: She made a great pitch to the new client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the past results or successes of a person or company
vocabulary.example: Our company has a good track record of delivering on time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the most important good points of something
vocabulary.example: The key strengths of this phone are its battery and its price.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being something people can trust to work well
vocabulary.example: Clients choose us because of our reliability.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that buys services from a business
vocabulary.example: Our number of clients doubled last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to become two times bigger
vocabulary.example: Our sales doubled in two years.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of pictures or pages shown on a screen
vocabulary.example: I'll continue without the slideshow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: short written points to help you remember
vocabulary.example: He looked at his notes before he spoke.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (of a computer) to suddenly stop working
vocabulary.example: My computer crashed in the middle of the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (of a screen) not moving or changing
vocabulary.example: The screen is frozen, so I can't change the slide.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the most important ideas
vocabulary.example: Give your key points one by one.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give facts that show something is true
vocabulary.example: Support each point with a fact.

vocabulary.meaning_en: natural, like normal talking
vocabulary.example: Try to be more conversational when you present.

vocabulary.meaning_en: looking directly at people's eyes
vocabulary.example: Look people in the eye to make good eye contact.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a prize for doing something well
vocabulary.example: Our product won an award last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: newest
vocabulary.example: Let me show you our latest product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way something is planned and made to look
vocabulary.example: Customers love the design of this chair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being able to change or be used in different ways
vocabulary.example: The key strengths are its design and flexibility.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to use a success as a base for more success
vocabulary.example: We hope to build on our good relationship.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to officially ask to buy goods
vocabulary.example: The client put in an order for 500 boxes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: thinking that something is very good
vocabulary.example: I hope you're impressed with our new product.

fine_lines.title: impressed vs impressive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: impressed تصف شعور الشخص (أنا معجب)، أما impressive فتصف الشيء الذي يسبب الإعجاب (منتج مبهر).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Impressed" describes how a person feels. "Impressive" describes the thing that causes the feeling.

examples.sentence: The client was impressed with our results.

fine_lines.title: client vs customer
fine_lines.explanation_ar: client غالبًا لمن يشتري خدمات أو يتعامل مع الشركة باستمرار، و customer لمن يشتري من متجر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A "client" usually buys services or works with a company over time. A "customer" buys things from a shop.

examples.sentence: We have a meeting with an important client.
The shop had many customers today.

expressions.phrase: The company has a strong track record of...
expressions.example: The company has a strong track record of happy clients.

expressions.meaning_en: used to point to something you did very well
expressions.example: We're particularly proud of our fast delivery.

expressions.meaning_en: used to list the best features
expressions.example: The product's key strengths are its size and price.

expressions.meaning_en: a friendly way to introduce information
expressions.example: Let me share with you our newest idea.

expressions.meaning_en: a short apology for a small problem
expressions.example: Sorry about that, the computer isn't working.

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to end a talk or meeting
expressions.example: Thank you for your time. Do you have any questions?

expressions.phrase: I'd like to put in an order for...
expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to order goods
expressions.example: I'd like to put in an order for two hundred boxes.

grammar.title: Supporting a point with a fact (because / thanks to)
grammar.explanation_ar: في العرض البيعي اذكر النقطة ثم ادعمها بحقيقة. استخدم because + جملة كاملة، و thanks to + اسم لتوضيح السبب.
grammar.explanation_en: In a pitch, give a point and then a fact to support it. Use "because + full sentence" and "thanks to + noun" to give the reason.
examples: We are growing fast – our clients doubled last year.
Clients trust us because we always deliver on time.
Thanks to new technology, our products are better than ever.

questions.question: What does "to pitch something" mean?
choices: to do a sales presentation about it
questions.explanation_ar: to pitch تعني تقديم عرض بيعي.
questions.explanation_en: To pitch means to give a sales presentation.

questions.question: Complete: The company has a strong track ___ of reliability.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير هو track record أي سجل الإنجازات.

questions.question: "Our key strengths are..." talks about...
questions.explanation_en: Key strengths are the most important good points.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: The client was impressive with our product.
The client was impressing with our product.
The client was impressed with our product.
The client impressed with our product.

questions.question: Complete: ___ to new technology, our products look better.
Which is the best advice for a pitch?
choices: Speak very fast like a robot
Read all your notes without stopping
Look people in the eye and smile
questions.explanation_ar: النصيحة: التواصل البصري والابتسام والتحدث بشكل طبيعي.
questions.explanation_en: Good advice: make eye contact, slow down and smile.

questions.question: Complete: We're particularly proud ___ our fast delivery.
Which phrase politely ends a pitch?
questions.explanation_ar: Thank you for your time عبارة مهذبة للختام.
questions.explanation_en: "Thank you for your time" is a polite ending.
